Repeats until acknowledged so you never miss important notifications.

Note
It wakes up the phone repeatedly and can cause more battery consumption.

Enable auto-reporting exclusively for specific regex rules by matching against their rule descriptions.

Example:
  Rule 1: .*won.*claim.*
  Description: scam
  Rule 2: .*balance.*bank.*
  Description: reminder

  Setting this filter to scam ensures only calls blocked by rule 1 get auto-reported.

The default setting .* enables auto-reporting for calls blocked by any regex rule.

Tip:
This is a regex field, match multiple rules using a pattern like (scam|ads|political).
Logs are saved only for workflows with the <highlight>Schedule</highlight> trigger type.

Manually classify some SMS messages to train your own spam filter, works completely locally.

Algorithm: Complement Naive Bayes.

This feature is currently experimental and may be updated or removed in future releases.

Train at least 50 messages, including both spam and ham(non-spam). The more samples you train it, the more accurate it will be.

Training

1. It shows about 1000 recent SMS records from unknown numbers, messages from contacts are excluded since they are always allowed.

2. Swipe some records to train the model.
  Swipe left - mark as spam
  Swipe right - mark as ham
  Tap it - unmark
  Each swipe trains the model immediately, the border color indicates its classification.

3. Tap the Test button, all messages will be classified by the trained model.

4. Review their text color. If any are incorrect, try training more samples.
  Numbers like 0.5000 are spam probabilities.
